_comment: MERGE example (Phase W3+): combine several transcripts into ONE word cloud. Here we merge the 3 git-tutorial videos by id into a single cloud named 'git-series'. Output: data/wordclouds/git-series.word_cloud.json. All selected transcripts must be the same language (guard applies). Change 'select'/'select_by' to pick different transcripts; change 'output_name' to rename the combined file.
